what: The held-out words of smCLM_02 and the ideas a person says each one carries. Phase 0 creates the file empty; phase 1 fills it, by hand, once held_out.py has picked the words and the idea inventory is approved. The teacher never writes a row here, and the teacher's tags for these words are dropped from data/tags.jsonl.
written_by: Claude (Opus 5) agent, phase 0 of docs/engineering/plans/smCLM_02.md; the rows themselves are for a person

fields.word: the held-out word, as it appears in data/vocabulary.jsonl
fields.ideas: the ideas this word carries, every one a key of ideas.json; at least one
fields.band: which frequency band held_out.py drew it from
fields.source: human, or v1 where the tags come straight from smCLM_01/concepts.json
fields.note: only where a word needed a word of explanation
